channel.title: GiveOwl – Christmas competitions 2026 (Australia)
channel.description: Christmas competitions and giveaways from Australian promoters for 2026, each checked on the promoter's own page. Many close in late November or early December, so check the closing date on each one. The purchase rule is on each entry; check the promoter's terms.

Free, no purchase necessary; Australian residents only. Newsletter tick-boxes are optional. Opens 6 Nov 2026, closes 10pm AEST on 20.11.2026; winners notified by email.

item.title: VegKit: Nanna's Christmas Hamper Giveaway – Animals Australia Limited (trading as VegKit.com)
item.description: Prize: One 'Nanna's Favourite Things Hamper' with food items and ingredients, kitchen utensils, Nanna's recipe booklet, a Bunnings gift voucher, a pig plush toy and merchandise (up to AU$550 plus up to AU$80 delivery; total up to AU$630). Submit the entry form on VegKit.com with your name and email (phone optional) and join the VegKit email list (Nanna Diaries emails); you must still be subscribed at the draw. Free, one entry per person. Australian residents 18+. 2 Nov 2026 12:00 am – 6 Dec 2026 11:59 pm AEDT; draw 7 Dec 2026. The hamper contains cooking vermouth, so the winner must verify they are 18+.
